Scoring multiple Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each causes your <bold next /> damage instance within 3 seconds (from any source) to trigger a <strand/>Severing Burst.

<strand/>Severing Burst applies <strand/>Sever to enemies in a 3? meter radius. Radius is increased to ? meters while Transcendent.

Further Precision Hits within 4 seconds of an activation provide no activation progress.

Precision Hits required to prepare the Severing Burst:
• 20% of magazine size rounded down + 1
• Bows require 2 hits
